definitions.gloss: to request, to ask (someone to do something)
definitions.explanation: To politely ask someone to do something or to make a request.

definitions.gloss: to pray for, to wish for
definitions.explanation: To pray or make a wish, often at a shrine or temple.

examples.japanese: お{願|ねが}いがあるんですが。
examples.english: I have a favor to ask.
examples.notes: Common way to introduce a request

examples.japanese: コーヒーをお{願|ねが}いします。
{先生|せんせい}に{手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}いてくださるようにお{願|ねが}いした。
examples.english: I asked the teacher to write a letter for me.

examples.japanese: よろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I look forward to working with you. / Please take care of this.
examples.notes: One of the most common polite expressions in Japanese

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しいところお{願|ねが}いして{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ないのですが、この{書類|しょるい}を{確認|かくにん}していただけますか。
examples.english: I'm sorry to trouble you when you're busy, but could you check this document?

examples.japanese: {神社|じんじゃ}で{合格|ごうかく}をお{願|ねが}いした。
examples.english: I prayed for success at the shrine.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}の{健康|けんこう}をお{願|ねが}いする。
examples.english: I pray for my family's health.

examples.japanese: お{寺|てら}で{無事|ぶじ}をお{願|ねが}いした。
examples.english: I prayed for safety at the temple.

examples.japanese: {七夕|たなばた}の{短冊|たんざく}に{願|ねが}いを{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote my wish on a Tanabata paper strip.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}お{正月|しょうがつ}に{神社|じんじゃ}へ{行|い}って、{一年|いちねん}の{幸|しあわ}せをお{願|ねが}いしている。
examples.english: Every year I go to the shrine at New Year's and pray for a year of happiness.

notes:
お{願|ねが}いする is the polite way to make a request. It is the honorific form of {頼|たの}む (to ask/request) and is essential for daily polite communication.

KEY EXPRESSIONS:
- お{願|ねが}いします: Please / I'd like to request this (extremely common)
- よろしくお{願|ねが}いします: Please take care of this / Nice to meet you / I look forward to working with you
- お{願|ねが}いがあるのですが: I have a favor to ask
- ぜひお{願|ねが}いしたい: I'd really like to ask you

SENSE 2 (PRAYER):
At shrines and temples, お{願|ねが}いする means to pray for something or make a wish: {神様|かみさま}にお{願|ねが}いする (to pray to God/the gods).

REGISTER:
お{願|ねが}いする is polite and appropriate in most situations. For casual requests, use {頼|たの}む instead. For very formal written requests, {依頼|いらい}する is used.
